chunks: 5867 - Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn Mālik al-Fazārī al-Kūfī narrated; he said: Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn Sahl narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Muḥammad, from Masʿadah, who said: Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon them, said to me:
Indeed, a man's family are his dependents. So whoever Allah blesses with a bounty, let him expand upon his dependents; and if he does not do so, that blessing is close to vanishing.

key_terms.أُسَرَاؤُهُ: those bound to him in dependence and responsibility
key_terms.تَزُولَ تِلْكَ النِّعْمَةُ: that blessing may depart or be taken away
key_terms.عِيَالَ الرَّجُلِ: a man's family and dependents under his care
key_terms.فَلْيُوَسِّعْ: let him spend more broadly and provide generously
key_terms.نِعْمَةً: a divine blessing or bounty granted by Allah

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام teach about providing generously for one’s family?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a person has a moral responsibility toward those under his care, especially his family. When Allah grants someone provision and blessing, he should show its effect by being generous to them. Neglecting one's dependents may become a cause for the loss of that divine favor.
